short_en: An annual killifish from Buenos Aires Province; nonoiuliensis is a historical associated name.
detail_en: It is recorded in Argentina in the Río de la Plata basin and along the Buenos Aires coast. The 2023 review places it in Cypholebias and treats nonoiuliensis as a synonym.
range_en: Argentina · Buenos Aires Province, Río de la Plata basin and Atlantic coast

short: Killi de cursos de agua de las Seychelles.
detail: Vive en cursos de agua de las islas Seychelles, tanto de agua dulce como salobre. Aunque el género también incluye especies de Madagascar, esta especie procede de Seychelles. Se clasifica como no anual.

short_en: A killifish from streams in the Seychelles.
detail_en: It lives in freshwater and brackish streams on the Seychelles islands. Although the genus also includes species from Madagascar, this species is native to the Seychelles. It is classified as non-annual.
range_en: Seychelles

name: Epiplatys annulatus
short: Pequeño killi de bandas claras y oscuras que frecuenta la superficie.
detail: Se registra en aguas someras y pantanosas de Sierra Leona y Monrovia. Puede poner huevos en mopas y plantas flotantes; los huevos y alevines son muy pequeños. Pseudepiplatys annulatus es otro nombre usado en el hobby.
range: Guinea · Liberia · Sierra Leona

short_en: A small, light-and-dark-banded killifish that stays near the surface.
detail_en: It is recorded in shallow, marshy waters in Sierra Leone and Monrovia. It may lay eggs in mops and floating plants; the eggs and fry are very small. Pseudepiplatys annulatus is another name used in the hobby.

detail_en: Its natural range is limited to seasonal pools and wetlands on Unguja, Tanzania. Its cycle is semi-annual; in captivity, the eggs develop in peat. Older references may include other populations under this name.

name: Argolebias paranaensis
range: Ayolas, sur de Paraguay · localidad conocida
short: Conocido solo por ejemplares preservados de Ayolas.
detail: La revisión de 2023 solo documenta ejemplares preservados de Ayolas, Paraguay. No describe su coloración en vida. Esta ficha todavía no confirma su ciclo de vida.
short_en: Known only from preserved specimens collected at Ayolas.
detail_en: The 2023 review only documents preserved specimens from Ayolas, Paraguay. It does not describe their live coloration. This profile does not yet confirm the species’ life cycle.
range_en: Ayolas, southern Paraguay · known locality

sources.label: Serra et al. 2023 · MNHN
claims: Argolebias paranaensis is assigned to the genus and is known only from original preserved specimens collected over 40 years ago in Ayolas, southern Paraguay; live coloration is unknown and there are no DNA sequences.

name: Garcialebias charrua
range: Rocha, Uruguay · región costera atlántica
short: Killi anual registrado en Rocha, Uruguay.
detail: Especie anual registrada en Rocha, Uruguay. La revisión de 2023 la ubica en Garcialebias; antes se conocía como Austrolebias charrua.
short_en: An annual killifish recorded in Rocha, Uruguay.
detail_en: An annual species recorded in Rocha, Uruguay. The 2023 review places it in Garcialebias; it was formerly known as Austrolebias charrua.
range_en: Rocha, Uruguay · Atlantic coastal region

sources.label: Serra et al. 2023 · MNHN
claims: The review uses Garcialebias charrua and identifies pictured specimens from Rocha, Uruguay; it describes the genus range across Uruguay and southern Brazil.

short: Killi anual registrado en Uruguay.
detail: La revisión de 2023 documenta ejemplares de Rocha, Uruguay, y reconoce el nombre Acantholebias luteoflammulatus. Antes se ubicaba en Austrolebias.
short_en: An annual killifish recorded in Uruguay.
detail_en: The 2023 review documents specimens from Rocha, Uruguay, and recognizes the name Acantholebias luteoflammulatus. It was previously placed in Austrolebias.
range_en: Rocha, Uruguay · eastern Atlantic basins

name: Cypholebias vazferreirai
range: Uruguay y Rio Grande do Sul, Brasil
short: Killi anual de cuencas de Uruguay y sur de Brasil.
detail: Es un killi anual de Uruguay y el sur de Brasil, hoy ubicado en Cypholebias. Un estudio de 2010 documentó su primer registro en Rio Grande do Sul, usando el nombre Austrolebias vazferreirai.
short_en: An annual killifish from basins in Uruguay and southern Brazil.
detail_en: It is an annual killifish from Uruguay and southern Brazil, now placed in Cypholebias. A 2010 study documented its first record in Rio Grande do Sul under the name Austrolebias vazferreirai.
range_en: Uruguay and Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil

name: Nematolebias whitei
range: Llanuras costeras del estado de Río de Janeiro, Brasil · cuencas de Araruama, das Ostras y río São João
short: Habita charcas estacionales de las llanuras costeras de Río de Janeiro.
detail: Las charcas donde vive pueden secarse dos veces al año. Los adultos mueren al secarse el agua, mientras los embriones permanecen en diapausa en el suelo hasta que vuelve la inundación. Acuaristas de la BKA describen su puesta en turba y arena.
short_en: It lives in seasonal pools on the coastal plains of Rio de Janeiro.
detail_en: Its pools can dry out twice a year. Adults die when the water dries, while embryos remain in diapause in the soil until the pools are flooded again. BKA aquarists describe spawning it in peat and sand.
range_en: Coastal plains of Rio de Janeiro state, Brazil · Araruama and das Ostras basins, and the São João River

sources.label: CAS · Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes
claims: Current valid name Nematolebias whitei; distribution in the Araruama basin, das Ostras River basin, and coastal plain by the São João mouth, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

sources.label: Thompson et al. 2022 · Genome of the Rio Pearlfish
sources.label_en: Thompson et al. 2022 · Genome of the Rio Pearlfish
claims: Calls N. whitei bi-annual; seasonal pools in Rio de Janeiro dry twice yearly; embryos enter diapause in soil and hatch after inundation.

sources.label: British Killifish Association · Nematolebias whitei husbandry account
sources.label_en: British Killifish Association · Nematolebias whitei husbandry account
claims: A direct keeper account reports this species as annual and describes spawning in peat or silver sand, then collecting and drying eggs in peat.

name: Hypsolebias magnificus
range: Cuenca media del río São Francisco · Bahía y Minas Gerais, Brasil
short: Killi estacional de las llanuras de inundación del São Francisco medio.
detail: Su distribución conocida abarca la cuenca media del São Francisco en Bahía y Minas Gerais. La especie forma parte del complejo de killis estacionales de la Caatinga; su localidad tipo está en la llanura de la margen derecha del río, cerca de Manga, Minas Gerais.
short_en: A seasonal killifish from the middle São Francisco floodplains.
detail_en: Its known range covers the middle São Francisco basin in Bahia and Minas Gerais. The species belongs to the Caatinga seasonal-killifish complex; its type locality is on the river's right-bank plain near Manga, Minas Gerais.
range_en: Middle São Francisco River basin · Bahia and Minas Gerais, Brazil

sources.label: CAS · Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes
claims: Current valid name Hypsolebias magnificus; distribution in the middle São Francisco basin, Bahia and Minas Gerais; type locality near Manga, Minas Gerais.

name: Millerichthys robustus
range: Cuencas de los ríos Papaloapan y Coatzacoalcos · Veracruz y Oaxaca, México
short: Killi anual endémico de las cuencas mexicanas del Papaloapan y Coatzacoalcos.
detail: Vive en charcas temporales de Veracruz y Oaxaca. El ciclo anual acompaña las fases locales de inundación y sequía: los embriones pasan por diapausas en el sustrato y eclosionan cuando vuelve el agua.
short_en: An annual killifish endemic to Mexico's Papaloapan and Coatzacoalcos basins.
detail_en: It lives in temporary pools in Veracruz and Oaxaca. Its annual cycle follows local flood and drought periods: embryos pass through diapause stages in the substrate and hatch when water returns.
range_en: Papaloapan and Coatzacoalcos river basins · Veracruz and Oaxaca, Mexico

sources.label: Domínguez-Castanedo, Valdesalici & Rosales-Torres 2017 · developmental ecology
claims: Identifies M. robustus as an annual killifish endemic to Papaloapan and Coatzacoalcos basins in Veracruz and Oaxaca; describes seasonal flood, drought, and humidity periods and embryo diapause.
sources.locator: sections Environmental Characteristics and annual environmental variation, lines 122–156

name: Anablepsoides hartii
range: Sur de las Antillas y norte de Sudamérica · Venezuela, Trinidad y Tobago, Aruba, Curazao, Margarita y Paria
short: Killi no anual de arroyos caribeños de Venezuela y las Antillas del sur.
detail: Se registra en arroyos costeros de Venezuela, tributarios del Orinoco y algunas islas del sur del Caribe. Es no anual. Las referencias antiguas pueden usar el nombre Rivulus hartii.
short_en: A non-annual killifish from Caribbean streams in Venezuela and the southern islands.
detail_en: It is recorded in Venezuelan coastal streams, Orinoco tributaries and some southern Caribbean islands. It is non-annual. Older references may use the name Rivulus hartii.
range_en: Southern Caribbean islands and northern South America · Venezuela, Trinidad and Tobago, Aruba, Curaçao, Margarita, and Paria

sources.label: CAS · Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes
claims: Current valid name Anablepsoides hartii; distribution includes Caribbean coastal river drainages, Trinidad and Tobago, and Venezuela.
